entry.idea: Lexroom uses generative AI to help lawyers research the law, draft documents and summarise cases in plain language questions.
entry.lesson: Build for a legal or regulatory system that bigger, US-first competitors overlook, and you get a whole region to yourself.
entry.name: Lexroom

growth.reason: Client base tripled and team doubled in just six months, with a Series B eight months after the Series A.

market.reason: Legal work is a large, real market, and civil law systems cover many countries, though this is one profession, not everyone.

tech.reason: Tailoring generative AI to civil law jurisdictions with high-quality legal sources is a real edge, though a strong team could build something similar in a year or two.

entry.twist: It is built specifically for civil law countries, a legal system used across much of Europe and Latin America that most legal AI tools ignore.
entry.who_pays: Lawyers and corporate legal teams pay to use the platform for research, drafting and case work.
entry.why_now: Law firms face growing caseloads and want AI that understands their own country's legal system, not just US law.
